precedents.summary: Missed Opportunity: scan validation disposition not updating status or removing item from queue
precedents.relevance: Closest precedent — disposition update flowing PG->CH and removing an item from a surface. Carries the WS6 perf-at-scale lesson (a 13-file approach was built + fully reviewed before its ~3.7s/query cost was measured, then reverted).
precedents.applicability: applicable — study how disposition update + queue-removal was approached and the CH-at-scale perf pitfall before adding a forDispositions() filter to the markers query.

precedents.summary: Scout — Hit modal: scaling/overlap fix + add vehicle info
precedents.relevance: The Scout hit modal that DEV-2059 extends with a disposition control.
precedents.applicability: applicable — this is the modal + component we add the disposition control to; match its conventions.

precedents.summary: Historical map icons must match left pane (open hits only; hide repossessed)
precedents.relevance: Precedent for filtering which hits appear as map markers vs left pane.
precedents.applicability: applicable — the markers query filtering (forDispositions) mirrors this hide-from-map pattern.

precedents.summary: align recentHits (left pane) + hit-density heatmap to current hotlist status
precedents.relevance: Precedent for aligning multiple Scout surfaces to a current status filter.
precedents.applicability: applicable — recent-hits already filters forDispositions([NEW_HIT, VALID]); the markers query must be brought in line.

precedents.summary: Scout Admin Map — live hits missing (ClickHouse hot/cold sync + ordering/type filter)
precedents.relevance: CH hot/cold hits sync mechanics + ordering/type filtering on the hits surface.
precedents.applicability: partial — informs how CH-backed hit surfaces are filtered and how hot/cold sync behaves.
